title: Discrete integer submodules of finite real vector spaces are finite
statement: Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional real normed vector space [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace], and let $L\subseteq V$ be a $\mathbf Z$-submodule, namely an additive subgroup with the induced integer scalar action. Suppose the topology on $L$ induced from $V$ is discrete, meaning that every singleton is open in $L$. Then $L$ is finitely generated as a $\mathbf Z$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module].
